body: Proprietary agent personas, role contracts, and system instructions constitute core enterprise IP. Shipping them as raw markdown or JSON on customer filesystems (on-prem/OEM) exposes Product Forge's competitive reasoning logic to reverse engineering and direct extraction. This item establishes the asset compiler and runtime decryptor to keep prompt IP secure.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.why: Protects core Product Forge intellectual property and prevents prompt extraction by reverse-engineering shipped binaries.
brief.problem: Proprietary system prompts and agent instructions are stored as plaintext markdown and JSON files, creating IP leakage risk in shipped commercial products.
brief.what_adds: Prompt and Persona Asset Compiler providing AES-256-GCM encryption, runtime transparent in-memory decryption in native Go, and zero-raw-prompt release gates.
brief.who_feels: Enterprise customers and platform operators demanding commercial-grade IP security.

label: PF Backlog 685
risks: Key derivation mismatch between compiler and runtime: mitigated via shared HKDF-SHA256 specification.
Accidental plaintext prompt inclusion in customer builds: mitigated via release packaging leak scanner failing closed.
title: Prompt and Persona Asset Compiler: secure compilation and runtime encryption for proprietary agent instructions

review.reasons: Senior Enterprise Architect Review: Aligned with ADR-0001, BI-PF-0387, and BI-PF-0388 single-source compiled delivery baseline. Sensitive prompt encryption and runtime decryption logic lands in native Go (go/promptcompiler) to prevent IP leakage; build tooling resides in scripts/dev/prompt_compiler.py adhering to config/language-rule.json. Approved for implementation under EPIC A (BI-PF-0390).

impact_review.recommendation: Implement core AES-256-GCM cipher and runtime decryption in Go (go/promptcompiler/); build-time CLI in scripts/dev/prompt_compiler.py.

impact_review.claim: API CHECK: packaging and offline asset compilation capability
impact_review.recommendation: Offline build-time compiler CLI and native Go runtime library; no unauthenticated HTTP API route required.

impact_review.claim: AC-1: AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with runtime key derivation
impact_review.recommendation: Implement tokenization and AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with HKDF key derivation.

impact_review.claim: AC-2: Shipped customer packages contain zero readable system prompt files
impact_review.recommendation: Enforce packaging scanner that fails closed if raw .md prompt files are detected in distribution payloads.

impact_review.claim: AC-3: In-memory runtime transparent decryption with zero disk leakage
impact_review.recommendation: Load encrypted asset bundles directly into memory and verify zero scratch file disk writes.

assumptions: Standard AES-256-GCM with 96-bit random nonce and 128-bit authentication tag is the enterprise standard for prompt asset protection.
The runtime decryption key is derived from the platform instance entitlement key / environment master key (via HKDF-SHA256).
Decrypted prompt text is loaded directly into the execution context in memory; no temporary decrypted files are ever written to disk.
Shipped commercial distributions (enterprise, on-prem, oem, saas) must fail-closed if raw prompt markdown files exist in the distribution payload.
divergences: None: Extends canonical A3/A5 packaging pipeline and implements runtime decryption in native Go without creating duplicate engines.
existing_path: Prompt & persona definitions: config/persona.json:1, config/agent-hierarchy.json:1, templates/prompts/
Shipped language rule: config/language-rule.json:4-8 (shipped_roots: core/, api/, adapters/)
prior_decisions: ADR-0001 / BI-PF-0388: Shipped editions use compiled artifacts; never raw .py; one source, many editions.
BI-PF-0387: Single-source delivery baseline; new shipped/sensitive logic lands in native Go (go/ directory).
BI-PF-0398: A3 compiled packaging pipeline + NO-RAW-.py release gate (enforces zero raw code leakage).
BI-PF-0399: A5 Runtime Dependency Compiler (composes EAP + profiles + OS/arch into runtime composition).

summary: Build an asset compilation and encryption pipeline that compiles agent prompts and persona templates into Go binary assets via embed.FS or encrypted asset packages with runtime license-key-derived decryption.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_hierarchy.py, core/agent_ledger.py

approach: Implement compile_prompts() pipeline that packages prompt markdown files into encrypted .bin bundles and catalogs them in EAP manifest.

controls.control: Enforce AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with HKDF-SHA256 key derivation for prompt asset bundles
Fail closed release packaging if raw plaintext markdown prompt files exist in distribution payloads
Derive tenant-partitioned bundle decryption keys via HKDF-SHA256 for process memory isolation
Resolve prompt input paths and master key from config and environment with strict validation
Log bundle manifest compilation statistics (entry count, ciphertext size, sha256 digest)
